content.short: Sepolia Faucet provides 1 SepoliaETH per day through a fast and reliable testnet faucet.
content.description: Sepolia Faucet is a free tool that helps web3 developers obtain Sepolia testnet tokens for the Sepolia network. After signing in, users enter their Sepolia wallet address and click Send Me ETH; an airdrop of 1 SepoliaETH is delivered directly to their wallet. These testnet tokens are intended for deploying, testing, and iterating smart contracts and decentralized applications on the Ethereum Foundation's recommended Sepolia testnet, enabling experimentation and development without using real funds.
content.meta: Sepolia Faucet is a free tool for web3 developers to claim Sepolia testnet tokens. Discover Sepolia Faucet and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
